title: Grid Path with Move and Removal Budgets
hints: Where you stand is not the whole story: two arrivals at the same cell can differ in how many removals they have left, and that changes what is reachable next.
Search over states that include the removals still available, exploring in order of moves used so the first arrival at the target is the cheapest in moves.
An arrival at a cell is useless if an earlier, shorter arrival there kept at least as many removals; and once removals cover any edge-hugging route, only the move count matters.
